scenarios.title: Design a safe, evidence-led community activity guide
scenarios.brief: Create a one-page guide for a fictional school/community activity day. Explain safe activity progression at a general level, communicate a simple schedule clearly, use truthful visual information and include safe escalation instructions.
deliverables: non-prescriptive activity schedule with rest and weather fallback
one simple chart from synthetic data, correctly labelled
household/event hazard observation and escalation checklist
reflection identifying what requires adult/qualified oversight
constraints: no real emergency-system or security details

scenarios.title: Produce a short accessible performance with a documented workflow
scenarios.brief: Plan and produce an original 45–60 second spoken performance or narrated visual explanation for a defined audience. The production should demonstrate intelligibility, accessible visual structure and ethical reference use.
deliverables: marked script with pacing and emphasis
two versioned recordings or equivalent live rehearsal evidence
listener comprehension notes and revision log
constraints: no forced vocal range or shouting

scenarios.title: Analyse a fictional team performance and propose a learning cycle
scenarios.brief: Use a fictional or permitted sports scenario to separate tactical decisions from execution, interpret workload cautiously and present a small evidence-based review.
deliverables: conservative practice microcycle with recovery and fallback
one chart with denominator and limitations
constraints: no maximal or unsupervised training test
do not infer medical status from performance
